findings.title: Type guard breaks callers that pass integers
findings.body: The new signature restricts `normalize_sku` to `str`, but `stockroom/receiving.py` line 12 calls it with an `int` (barcode). This will raise `TypeError` at runtime, breaking the receiving flow. Either restore the union type or convert the argument in the caller.

findings.title: Redundant type guard with docstring
findings.body: The function now enforces `str` via the type signature and the runtime check on line 8–9, but the docstring on line 7 does not mention the restriction. Remove the redundant guard or update the docstring to clarify that only strings are accepted.

summary.problem: The new signature breaks existing callers and adds a redundant runtime check.
summary.done_well: The function now has a clear docstring and consistent internal formatting.
